{{Quote|This battle is inevitable. You can stand by your beliefs, but let us stand by ours.|Anakin Skywalker, to Tee Watt Kaa|audio=AnakinLemurBeliefs.flac|<ref name="dop" />}}
The '''Defense of Maridun''', also known as the '''Battle of Maridun''', took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]—along with [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|CC-5052]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]]—crash-landed on the planet, they discovered a local [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] village. The village, guided by Lurmen pacifist [[Tee Watt Kaa/Legends|Tee Watt Kaa]], wanted to remain neutral in the war. However, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] sent Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] to investigate the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet. The general planned to attack the Lurmen village with the Separatists' new weapon, the [[Defoliator/Legends|Defoliator]], a weapon capable of eliminating organic matter while leaving machinery intact.

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the two clones helped protect the Lurmen by stealing two [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generators]] from Durd's base on the planet. The shields protected the village from the defoliator's initial energy blast, prompting Durd to dispatch a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of his [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to attack the village. However, the Jedi and the two clone officers—along with the help of [[Wag Too/Legends|Wag Too]], Kaa's son—successfully destroyed the [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and Skywalker was able to eliminate the new Separatist weapon, as well as capture Durd.

==Prelude==
{{Dialogue|Secura|Everyone, please listen, the Separatists will be here in moments!|Kaa|What are you doing here? I told you not to return.|Skywalker|I'm afraid the Separatists don't care if you're in the war or not.|attr=Secura and Skywalker informing Kaa about the inevitable Separatist attack|src=<ref name="dop" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Defenders of Peace Date" /> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], crash-landed on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]]. Prior to crashing on Maridun, Skywalker was injured from an explosion onboard Secura's [[Liberty (Venator-class)/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]; as the later, Secura, Tano and two [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] officers were fleeing the damaged [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. However, while escaping on an [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]], the shuttle malfunctioned and activated its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], causing it to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. As the shuttle traveled through hyperspace, [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|CC-5052]] warned Secura that their shuttle was heading towards a [[Star/Legends|star]], which was near the planet of Maridun. CC-5052 and Tano managed to maneuver the cruiser around the star, however, the star caused damage to the shuttle.<ref name="JC" />

Crash-landing on the nearby planet of Maridun, the Jedi escorted the injured Skywalker while the clones established a camp near the cruiser wreckage. As [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] remained with Skywalker, the rest of the group found a [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] village. The Lurmen colonists were guided by [[Tee Watt Kaa/Legends|Tee Watt Kaa]], who avoided the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by leaving the Lurmen homeworld of [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]].<ref name="dopC">{{SW|url=video/defenders-of-peace-episode-featurette|text="Defenders of Peace" Episode Featurette}}</ref> As the Jedi and clones remained in the village, they learned that Kaa believed that war was an unnecessary act and preferred to remain neutral. Kaa advised the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to leave their colony, however, Tano pleaded for them to help Skywalker, who was deeply hurt. Allowing his son, [[Wag Too/Legends|Wag Too]], to leave with the Tano and CC-5052, Secura remained with the Lurmen. Too, CC-5052, and Tano returned to the colony with the injured Skywalker and was to be taken care of by Too's ability as an [[Medic/Legends|healer]].<ref name="JC" />

Shortly after, [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] began to descend from Maridun's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. His [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] landed near the Lurmen village and was soon greeted by Kaa. Durd ordered the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of his [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] to ransack the village to find any trace of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] contraband. Unbeknownst to them, the Jedi and the two clones hid from Durd with the guidance of Kaa's son [[Wag Too/Legends|Wag Too]]. After the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] found nothing, Durd and his droids left the area and departed for the established Separatist base on Maridun. The Republic group soon discovered the Separatist base while hiding on a tree that overlooked the base. Durd contacted Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] and revealed the new Separatist weapon—the [[Defoliator/Legends|defoliator]], a weapon capable of eliminating organic matter while leaving machinery intact.<ref name="dop" />

[[File:Durd_in_command.png|thumb|left|220px|Durd ordering his troops to attack the Jedi and Lurmen.]]
Durd then ordered two [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] to walk near a tree for the demonstration, the tree was the hiding location of the Republic group. After the successful testing of the defoliator, Durd told Dooku that his plan involved attacking a Lurmen village with the weapon. Durd, along with a battalion of battle droids, soon departed the base with the defoliator and headed for the Lurmen village.

==The defense==
===Stealing a ship===
The Jedi and clones secretly entered the Separatist base, destroyed all the stationed droids around the base, before the group found two [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generators]] and commandeered Durd's [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] within the bunker. Before Durd could arrive at the village, the Republic group landed in the village and alerted Kaa and the villagers of the imminent Separatist attack. However, Kaa disagreed with the Jedi, and warned them that they shouldn't have returned to their village.<ref name="dop" />

===Protecting the Lurmen village===
{{Quote|Good-bye Jedi. Fire!|Durd, ordering the Defoliator to target the Lurmen village|<ref name="dop" />}}
Secura and Tano began to [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force pull]] seed pods around the village as a protective barrier, although Kaa continued to oppose their help while his son expressed his sorrow that he could not help the Jedi due to his father's beliefs. Meanwhile, Durd continued to march towards the village with the defoliator and a battalion of battle droids. CT-7567 spotted the Separatists and warned Skywalker and Tano, though Skywalker commented that the Separatists would not attack if they kept their distance and only use the defoliator. Durd, meanwhile, prepared to fire the first defoliator [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] battery at the village. The Confederate officer hoped he could withstand and win the battle, which would grant him a promotion.<ref name="dop" />

After Durd gave the order to his [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Pune Zignat/Legends|technician]], the artillery battery was fired into the air. However, the Jedi managed to activate the two shield generators that they had taken from the Separatist base, which protected the entire village from the defoliator's energy blast. Responding to this, Durd ordered the [[Squad One (Lok Durd)/Legends|first squad]] of his army to march towards the village. The Jedi and the two clone officers attacked and destroyed all of the droids, though Durd then ordered the [[Squad Two (Lok Durd)/Legends|second]] and [[Squad Three (Lok Durd)/Legends|third]] squad of battle droids to attack the Republic force as well. In the village, a group of Lurmen that were willing to fight began to gather with the Jedi. While they did so, Kaa ordered them not to get involved, though the Lurmen villagers attacked the battle droids that marched past the shield and into the village.<ref name="dop" />

[[File:Defoliator_destroyed.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Skywalker destroys the defoliator.]]
Meanwhile, an [[Unidentified OOM command battle droid (Maridun)/Legends|OOM command battle droid]] noticed Skywalker approaching the defoliator weapon. Durd ordered his troops to fire at the Jedi; however, before the battle droids loaded another artillery battery in the weapon, Skywalker managed to destroy the weapon by severing the cannon and the rest of the stationed droids. Durd reacted and prepared to flee, but the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to prevent the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] from escaping.<ref name="dop" />

==Aftermath==
After capturing Durd and Zignat, Wag Too and Tee Wat Kaa thanked the Jedi for restoring peace within their village. The Jedi, CC-5052, and CT-7567 awaited the arrival of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] and his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], consisting of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], to pick up the Republic group and their prisoners.<ref name="dop" />

==Behind the scenes==
This battle on Maridun was featured in "[[Defenders of Peace]]," an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the [[2008]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which first aired on [[January 23]], [[2009]].<ref name="Defenders of Peace Ep Guide" />
